note: Published FiR 1 K63 in-phantom beam-quality figures (Seppala 2002 HU-P-D103; TECDOC-1223; inter-facility standard-model comparison tables). Tolerances are deliberately wide: the published values fold a clinical tumor:normal boron concentration ratio (~3.5) into the dose weighting, while the computed convention applies CBE factors only on a trace-loaded (~0.1 ppm B-10) phantom. The comparison verifies order-of-magnitude beam quality, not the published weighting convention itself. Statistical uncertainty of the 20M-history dose fold is negligible relative to the convention gap.
